name: splitLengths_length_getElem
statement: Type*} (l : List α) (sz : List ℕ) (h : sz.sum ≤ l.length) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < (sz.splitLengths l).length) : (sz.splitLengths l)[i].length = sz[i]'(by simpa using hi)

name: length_mem_splitLengths
statement: Type*} (l : List α) (sz : List ℕ) (b : ℕ) (h : ∀ n ∈ sz, n ≤ b) : ∀ l₂ ∈ sz.splitLengths l, l₂.length ≤ b
